changeSet.author: evt-l5
changeSet.comment: Decision H.1 of 2026-11-26 (user): the payment of a delivery goes through the Kernel escrow, held with the client's code; the receive-code transfer to the delivery person is gone, with its columns (added by changeset 071). No data to keep: a receive code lives a few minutes.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE deliveries DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS receive_code; ALTER TABLE deliveries DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS receive_code_expires_at;
